name: wow-forever-link
description: Lets Claude see your WoW Forever character live while you play. Read-only.
long_description: Reads the ClaudeLink addon's strip of colored squares in a corner of the game window, the addon's saved report and the game's combat log file, so Claude can see your health, target, pet, cooldowns, quests, bags and more while you play. It also installs the ClaudeLink addon into your WoW Forever folder. It never presses keys or plays for you.

tools.name: get_live_state
tools.description: Your character right now: health, target, pet, buffs, cooldowns, fight, money, location

tools.name: get_recent_events
tools.description: What just happened: combat, deaths, low health, errors, level ups

tools.name: get_health_timeline
tools.description: Health and power second by second

tools.name: get_full_report
tools.description: Spellbook, bags, quests, gear, talents, past fights and deaths

tools.name: get_quest_guide
tools.description: Where to go for each quest (from Questie)

tools.name: get_combat_log
tools.description: Hit-by-hit lines from the game's combat log file

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: A picture of the game window

tools.name: get_link_status
tools.description: Check that the link to the game works

wow_dir.title: WoW Forever folder
wow_dir.description: The _forever_ folder inside your World of Warcraft folder.

auto_update.title: Automatic updates
auto_update.description: On each start, download the newest version from GitHub (natanel80/claudelink-wow) and update the addon in the game.

github_token.title: GitHub token (not needed)
github_token.description: Leave empty. Only needed if natanel80/claudelink-wow is ever made private (a read-only token for it).
